Prepare yourselves Daevas! The server pairings have been revealed. Find your server below to see which server will become your next enemy in Atreia. 

What is Server Matchmaking?

As you journey through Atreia, you'll get chances to face another server in modes such as Spacetime Rifts and the Abyss.

For example, if the Asmodian server Israphel is paired with the Elyos server Siel, every Israphel Asmodian who enters the Abyss will run into Siel's Elyos. Those are the players you'll be clashing with, competing against, and… holding grudges against.


Will My Server Pairing Always Be the Same? 

No. We will update server pairings periodically to keep the combat balanced. For this reason, the same faction may now be matched together (Example: Asmodian vs. Asmodian). Today's pairing may be replaced by a new challenger down the road, so make your mark while you can. Good luck Daevas!
